content.short: Chainrails accepts crypto, card, Apple Pay and bank payments through one integration.
content.description: Chainrails gives merchants a single integration covering crypto, cards, Apple Pay and bank transfers, handling cross-chain routing, settlement and payment links behind it. Merchants generally do not want a crypto payment product specifically; they want one checkout that happens to accept it alongside everything else.
